items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: in came Sidney Mills from Mills, say, trying to sell Maxine Williams to Joe Helbock

ctx.x: Right. So anyway, I had already started working at the Onyx Club. And in came Sidney Mills from Mills, say, trying to sell Maxine Williams to Joe Helbock -- and I was on the stand singing at the time.
And Joe Helbock already knew that I had been to the office. So anyway, he let Sidney rave on. He said, "I got a girl coming from Pittsburgh, she's sensational," blah, blah, blah.
